el.Sos artista, músico o creador y no sabés: You're an artist, musician or creator and you don't know how to turn your work into consistent digital income.
el.Posteás pero no convertís — tenés presen: You post but you don't convert — you have a presence on social media, but no clarity on what you're selling or to whom.
el.Sos community manager o Social Media Man: You're a community manager or Social Media Manager and you want to specialize in a growing niche with interesting people.
el.Querés aprender con otros artistas, no e: You want to learn alongside other artists, not on your own — the group is part of the value.
el.Ya hiciste cursos de redes y no te funci: You've already taken social media courses and they didn't work for you — because they taught you how to post, not how to sell.
el.Necesitás acompañamiento continuo, no un: You need ongoing support, not a one-off session and goodbye — week-by-week follow-up.
el.Estás dispuesto a trabajar tu proyecto e: You're ready to work on your project seriously, with a method and no shortcuts.
el.La Formación es una suscripción. Podés s: The Program is a subscription. You can join whenever you like.
el.El ciclo formativo completo dura 90 días: The full training cycle lasts 90 days. You join, start with this week's class, and go through the whole cycle.

el.Cada semana hay una clase teórica con un: Every week there's a theory class on a specific, concrete, proven topic — plus one hour of Semilla group time for live questions with Agus about your own project.
el.El modelo que usamos — el Método Semilla: The model we use — the Método Semilla — has three pillars: business, communication and advertising. All three together, not separately.
el.Los artistas no hacen contenido. Hacen a: Artists don't make content. They make art.
el.No pierdas el tiempo tratando de ser inf: Don't waste your time trying to be an influencer. Keep making art and connect with the people who are looking for what you do.
el.Definís qué vendés, a quién y por qué al: Define what you sell, to whom, and why someone would pay for it. Products, income streams, pricing, real goals.
el.No pierdas el tiempo. Comunicá Marca y P: Don't waste your time. Communicate Brand and Product. Your voice, your audience, your message. Communication that converts — not just that gets likes.
el.Aprendé a hacer anuncios avanzados en Me: Learn to create advanced ads on Meta, how to measure results and how to project the growth of your business.
el.Temas puntuales, concretos y probados: c: Specific, concrete, proven topics: how to run a qualified-follower campaign, keep a clean profile, launch on Spotify, think through your business model, measure results, build your digital business spreadsheet and more.

el.Todo queda grabado y accesible desde nue: Everything is recorded and available on our platform so you can watch it throughout the 90 days of the course. You also get access to all the materials.

el.Su enfoque convierte proyectos culturale: His approach turns cultural projects into sustainable digital businesses, with clear and effective strategies.
